# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-08-31 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- 08/31: Ravens finalized their initial 53-man roster, keeping three QBs — Lamar Jackson, Tyler Huntley, and UDFA Joe Fagnano, who called making the team "pretty surreal." [Zrebiec](https://x.com/jeffzrebiec/status/2094532945226670550)
- 08/31: RB Adam Randall placed on IR with a designation to return; DC Jesse Minter said Randall had been "dealing with something" in camp and the move gives him a chance to get fully healthy. [Shaffer](https://x.com/jonas_shaffer/status/2094532196702769289)
- 08/31: DT Nnamdi Madubuike (neck) stays on the 53-man roster rather than IR; Minter said the team doesn't expect him to miss four games. [Shaffer](https://x.com/jonas_shaffer/status/2094532780814188954)
- 08/31: Ravens signed veteran K Jake Moody to the practice squad as competition after Tyler Loop's uneven preseason. [The Banner](https://www.thebanner.com/sports/ravens-nfl/ravens-sign-kicker-jake-moody-practice-squad-tyler-loop-H7GWYTA6ZREXZBOI6GCCTJ7OSU/)
- 08/31: Ravens made no waiver claims and lost interior lineman Corey Bullock, claimed off waivers by Carolina. [Zrebiec](https://x.com/jeffzrebiec/status/2094483359959249268)
- 08/31: WR Zay Flowers sat out practice with an apparent lower-body injury; Minter said last week he should be ready for Week 1. [Shaffer](https://x.com/jonas_shaffer/status/2094507442394574966)

## Transactions
- 08/31: Ravens lost C/G Corey Bullock, claimed off waivers by Carolina. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/transactions)
